human_in_loop_decisions: Mandatory human or editorial sign-off before any AI-drafted, AI-dubbed, or AI-assisted content is exported or published, with the reviewer holding authority to hold, reject, or override the automated check.
strongest_guardrails: A hard, unbypassable export or publish gate that blocks completion unless either an automated grounding, similarity, or disclosure check passes with logged evidence, or a named human reviewer records an override decision with identity and timestamp.
cross_industry_pattern: Across three independently designed content-creator AI products in this group (a pre-publish AI-dubbing and compliance copilot, a marketing-copy drafting assistant, and a script-ideation copilot), the worst documented harms consistently landed on people who are not the product's paying customer, such as viewers, original authors, publishers, and impersonated real people, rather than on the creator using the tool. The only guardrail that held across all three designs was a hard export or publish gate requiring machine-verified evidence or a logged human sign-off; no member found automation alone sufficient. This makes 'no export or publish without an evidenced human-or-verified-gate decision' a platform-level release requirement for any future content-creator AI feature, not a per-feature judgment call.
